Plan: Reject invalid executor invocations before spawn, from one shared alias-aware argparse surface
Summary: The generated executor spawns every dispatched script blindly, so an invented subcommand or flag surfaces only as a raw argparse `exit_code: 2` with usage text on stderr and **nothing on stdout** — a shape a caller that parses stdout reads as empty rather than as a correction. This plan derives each registered script's argparse accept-set (its verb tree, subcommand aliases, and per-verb flags) at generation time by asking each script for its own `--help`, embeds the result in the executor [...]
